description: 1 x Scots Pine (applicants ref. T6) - Remove major deadwood over 40mm diameter and/or over 1m length. 1 x Scots Pine (applicants ref. T7) - Remove major deadwood over 40mm diameter and/or over 1m length. 1 x Ash (applicants ref. T10) - Reduce crown by around 4m height and spread, pruning to suitable growth points where possible, to reduce the likelihood of branches failing in strong winds. Remove major deadwood over 40mm diameter and/or over 1m length.1 x Elm (applicants ref. T15) - Remove as close to trees current ground level as possible, leaving the stump in the ground.1 x Apple (applicants ref. T1) - Remove dead branch stub.1 x Apple (applicants ref. T5) - Remove dead branch at 0.4m to SE. 2 x Arizona Cypress (applicants ref G1) - Remove dead lower branches. Sever and clear a 1m section of Ivy from the circumference of the stem. 2 x Leyland Cypress (applicants ref. G2) - Sever and clear a 1m section of Ivy from the circumference of the stem. 2 x Lawson Cypress (applicants ref. G3) - Trim lower growth back without losing green foliage cover, up to around 2m over footpath. 1 x Leyland Cypress (applicants ref. H1) - Trim top and sides back to previous points without losing green foliage cover on vertical faces, as part of continued maintenance to manage size and appearance.
